text:
marta: quick heads-up — ran a mini-survey with the onboarding sampleapp and hit a replay problem when auth token rotation + 429 surge happened. repro attached.
chris: can you paste the minimal repro? which SDK/lang?
marta: node sampleapp using our oauth flow, auto-refresh. Steps:
```
1) start sampleapp with concurrency=50
2) trigger token rotation (short TTL)
3) spike requests (burst script)
```
Logs show duplicate webhook POSTs and DB inserts.
marta: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:10Z ERROR request-handler id=abc123 status=429
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z INFO retrying request id=abc123 attempt=2
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z INFO request succeeded id=abc123
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z WARN duplicate side-effect webhook id=abc123
```
samir: do we have idempotency header in sampleapp? looks like no.
chris: sampleapp uses `X-Request-ID` but not enforced server-side. SDK doesn't auto-generate idempotency keys for non-create calls.
natalie: possible race: client refresh obtains new token while server returns 429 and client retries without tying retry to idempotency key — double side-effect.
marta: exact. repro shows token rotate caused auth refresh mid-flight; retries are immediate with jitter 0-50ms — too small. burst + no idempotency = dup.
chris: propose two fixes: 1) increase jitter/backoff for token-refresh path, maybe exponential with base 2 and cap 2s; 2) have SDK auto-insert idempotency key for POST-like endpoints and provide opt-out.
samir: agree. also add server-side safe-replay window telemetry to detect dup rates.
devex-bot: FYI created ticket DE-4821 and linked sampleapp PR.
marta: thx — can we ship a temporary mitigation in sampleapp quickly? I'll open a PR to add `Idempotency-Key: uuidv4()` for webhook calls and bump retry jitter to 200-800ms.
chris: please also add a test harness script `surge_sim.sh` that repros with variable token TTLs + concurrency. we can add to devex/playgrounds.
natalie: when you add telemetry, include `x-replay-detected: true` so console can show per-route dup spikes.
marta: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/987 — includes patch and note in README. tl;dr: consequences for SDK: we should standardize idempotency header name and default jitter/backoff for refresh path.
chris: let's discuss SDK changes in async meeting Friday 10am. cc @samir @natalie
marta: thanks all :thumbsup:
